purpose: Reading Island promotional illustration posters; not application screenshots
prompts:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished premium Chinese social-media promotional poster for the open-source reading companion app 共读岛 / Reading Island. Portrait aspect ratio 3:4, ideally 1536x2048, crisp publication quality. This is poster 1 of a cohesive three-poster campaign. A quiet literary editorial aesthetic: warm cream uncoated paper, subtle fine kraft-paper texture along edges, dark cocoa brown typography, muted sage details, a little antique gold. Spacious asymmetric grid, refined large Songti Chinese headline and tiny well-kerned sans-serif English labels. Lower middle: an artful open book with sculpted curled paper pages and two small translucent paper conversation slips rising gently from it; a small graceful ink-outline swallow with long pointed wings and forked tail flies above the book. Flat editorial paper-collage illustration, tactile soft shadows, sophisticated restrained composition. The typography is the main hero; avoid busy ornament, no robots, no people, no fake product screenshot, no QR code, no external brand logos. Keep all copy well inside safe margins. Main headline near upper third, illustration center/lower, highly legible footer at bottom. Render ONLY the following exact text, without invention, with every Chinese glyph and URL correct:
Top brand: "共读岛"
Small English: "READING ISLAND"
Large headline on two lines: "和你的 AI" / "一起读一本书"
Supporting line: "摘录喜欢的句子，聊故事，也聊你的看法。"
Small feature line: "原文摘录 · 议题讨论 · 持续共读"
Footer label: "开源 · 自带模型 Key"
Footer URL, one line prominently and clearly: "github.com/birdisleeee/reading-island"
The footer URL is essential: github.com slash birdisleeee slash reading-island. Make the URL large enough to read on a phone. Do not add claims of free AI, unlimited quotas, notifications, or fully automated reading.
